component.name: Ezoo Download
component.summary: Download manager for HTTP, HLS, DASH, video and torrents
مدير تحميلات يدعم HTTP و HLS و DASH والفيديو والتورنت

description.p: Ezoo Download is a desktop download manager written in Rust. It splits files over up to 32 connections, resumes after interruptions, and keeps running next to the clock when its window is closed.
Ezoo Download مدير تحميلات مكتوب بلغة Rust: يقسّم الملف على عدة اتصالات، يستأنف بعد الانقطاع، ويبقى بجوار الساعة عند إغلاق النافذة.
Ezoo Download was created by Ahmed Ezzat (Ezoo Tech). This package is built from the fork, based on the upstream project; all author credits are kept.

ul.li: HLS (.m3u8) and DASH (.mpd) video streams with AES-128 support
Video and audio from the browser via its extension
Torrents and magnets (aria2), YouTube via yt-dlp
System tray icon, queue, scheduler, speed limits, grabber
Eight languages with an Arabic-first interface

description.p: Fork release: quality choice in the capture window now steers the download (HLS variant URL, DASH quality key), capture rows with name, size, Preview and Copy-link buttons, refresh-link for expired links, per-site connection limits, split-half work-stealing on stalled segments, file and torrent link interception with automatic retry in the browser extension, signed release checksums, and a per-install token for the local bridge.

Fork release: adaptive multi-connection download engine, bundled Carlito, Noto Sans Arabic and Liberation Serif fonts, update checker against the fork's releases, Flatpak packaging, and the fix for dialogs rendering side by side on Wayland.
First Linux release: .deb and AppImage packaging, system tray for KDE/GNOME/XFCE, embedded Arabic and Latin fonts, and DASH (.mpd) stream downloads.
